reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that adds draggable, minimizable animated desktop pets with locally persisted selection and position.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加可拖拽、可缩小并支持动画切换的桌宠浮层。
summaries.en: Adds draggable, minimizable animated desktop-pet overlays to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

capabilities: renders draggable desktop-pet overlays inside the Web UI
supports minimizing and cycling among pet animations
persists pet selection and position in browser local storage
integrates as a client-side Web UI plugin
